code_investigation.finding: intent:unknown is INTENDED design — INTENT_RULES (lines 140-176) only fire on literal Jyotish technique vocabulary (dasha, transit/gochar, yoga, bala) per DR-8 deterministic-first ruling (module header lines 6-19); neither test query contains such terms so unknown+fallback is documented behavior. HOWEVER domains:["general"] is a REAL GAP: DOMAIN_RULES (lines 178-189) uses stale non-plural-safe regexes — marriage regex (line 181) does not match 'married', career regex (line 180) does not match 'jobs' (plural). A parallel, already-fixed list DEEP_DOMAIN_WORD (lines 232-233, 'F-Omega4-1 robustness fix', line 231) DOES contain married/marriages?/jobs? and correctly fires (explaining route:deep), but DOMAIN_RULES (the one that actually populates scope_tuple.domains and factors into confidence) was never given the same fix. Result: two realistic, canonical Jyotish questions both collapse to domains:['general'] and near-zero confidence (0.1 and 0) despite the system having, in a sibling code path, the correct regex to recognize them.
